extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: cable car / aerial gondola cabin for 8 persons with hanger, carriage and a short piece of track rope, approx. 2.5 x 4.6 x 5.4 m (cabin width x rope length x total height), cabin 2.5 x 2.0 x 2.4 m
extras.notes: the rope runs along the Y axis (glTF -Z/+Z); the cabin stands on its floor (z = 0) for easy placement - in use it hangs from the rope; 4 carriage sheaves are separate objects with origin on their axle (rotate around local X to roll along the rope); sliding doors on both long sides are modelled closed; opaque tinted windows all around, no interior; no brand, no text, no numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
